purpose: Extract transferable business mechanisms from real successes and failures without copying their products or weakening the Attraction Field.

launch_decision_clock.deadline_meaning: By this date the system must either have at least one genuinely high-attraction formation in decisive external validation or expand the source universe/mechanism diversity. It must not launch a weak experiment merely to satisfy the clock.

precedents.name: Pieter Levels / Nomad List + Remote OK + PhotoAI
precedents.observed_result: Stripe interview states Nomad List reached about $700k ARR, Remote OK about $3.4m revenue, and PhotoAI about $600k ARR, operated by Levels.
precedents.transfer_claim: Small operators can own narrow digital control surfaces when the user state is legible and delivery is mostly machine-native.
precedents.anti_copy_warning: Do not copy digital-nomad/job/AI-photo verticals; Levels also has unusually strong accumulated public distribution.

precedents.name: Carrd
precedents.observed_result: Indie Hackers reports Carrd above $2m ARR with a deliberately constrained one-page-site capability and little paid marketing.
precedents.transfer_claim: Capability-narrowing can enlarge addressable use cases while keeping activation/support extremely simple.
precedents.anti_copy_warning: Do not infer that generic SaaS or freemium is attractive; the mechanism depends on obvious utility and product-led spread.

precedents.name: Photopea
precedents.observed_result: Indie Hackers reports roughly $250k monthly revenue from a broadly used browser image editor whose core use is immediately accessible without installation.
precedents.transfer_claim: A strong state jump can be obvious enough that distribution comes from existing task intent rather than founder persuasion.
precedents.anti_copy_warning: Do not copy image editing or ad monetization; free utility without a monetizable or compounding control position is not automatically attractive.

precedents.name: OpenRouter
precedents.observed_result: OpenRouter reported 8m+ developers, 400+ models and weekly volume growth from 5T to 25T tokens over six months in May 2026.
precedents.transfer_claim: When many independent rails are callable and users already have high-frequency intent, a neutral routing/control layer can become a high-energy system.
precedents.anti_copy_warning: Do not copy AI model routing; the relevant lesson is callable multi-rail orchestration plus native usage flow, not the vertical.

precedents.name: Skyscanner affiliate / metasearch rail
precedents.observed_result: Skyscanner documents revenue sharing when referred traffic converts into bookings.
precedents.transfer_claim: Monetization is stronger when it rides the same completed flow that creates user value instead of requiring a separate sale.
precedents.anti_copy_warning: Do not build another travel comparator; mature vertical incumbents can already own the control surface.

precedents.name: Acquire.com
precedents.observed_result: Acquire states that since 2019 it has helped over a thousand founders sell businesses, closed over $500m in deal volume and registered over 500k entrepreneurs.
precedents.transfer_claim: A marketplace becomes powerful when both sides self-identify with high transaction intent and standardized evidence compresses trust/diligence.
precedents.anti_copy_warning: Do not infer that any marketplace is attractive; recurring manual advisory, supply acquisition or trust work can destroy founder-independence.

precedents.name: BuiltWith
precedents.observed_result: BuiltWith describes a durable web-technology intelligence platform, lead-generation product and API built on automated technology profiling across the internet.
precedents.transfer_claim: Repeated machine observation can create a compounding decision asset that becomes more valuable than any single lookup.
precedents.anti_copy_warning: Do not copy website technology intelligence; search for other recurring observable state where accumulated history improves a valuable decision.

precedents.name: Reddit solo SaaS $89k self-report
precedents.observed_result: Founder self-reports about $89k revenue, largely from cold outreach, lifetime deals and shipping quickly, while recurring revenue remains inconsistent.
precedents.transfer_claim: Revenue success alone is not sufficient for this project if the flow depends on recurring founder acquisition or non-regenerative sales.
precedents.anti_copy_warning: Use as a negative control. This is exactly the kind of financially real but model-misaligned path that urgency must not force into launch.

search_direction_rule: Generate mechanism-level search directions from repeated patterns, then require a fresh real-world AttractionDiscoveryProfile. Precedents never satisfy participant pull, discoverability, action callability, operator control, economics or validation for a new candidate.
experiment_rule: No experiment is allowed merely because it is fast or cheap. Only an already HIGH_ATTRACTION_BEACON may receive a reversible decisive reality test, and founder-manufactured demand cannot count.
